$comment: Content profiles - which tool packs and brand catalog make up one brand. packages/node-shell/src/content-roots.ts resolves the active one per process from LOLLY_PROFILE, the sticky .lolly-profile, then `default`; `pnpm run profile` prints what it resolved and from where, and a catalog script takes --profile=<name>. There are no repo-root tools/ and catalog/ views any more (plan 244). Later tool roots win on id collisions, so a brand pack can override a community tool. Optional `exclude`: tool ids to drop from this profile (e.g. a community tool a brand does not want to ship) - the tool stays available to every other profile.
